notes: All 25 candidates are not-a-list. Three nyusternldp.blogs.stern.nyu.edu pages are essay-mill spam on a hijacked NYU Stern blog subdomain (whole host can be discarded). The Kellogg doctoral placement landing page (https://www.kellogg.northwestern.edu/doctoral/placement/, 2024-2026 captures) carries no names in the saved capture, but it is the right program page and has 4 pages below it that may hold the job-market candidate and placement lists; worth checking those or a live fetch. The TU Darmstadt Computational Engineering 'PhD theses completed' page does list named doctoral graduates with thesis titles (no placements), but the graduate school is computational engineering, outside the operations/management scope; classified not-a-list for that reason. Everything else is thesis-office instructions, bachelor's/master's thesis ads or lists (EINS, HST), a master's thesis record (RWTH Informatik 5), news items, or an unrelated AP high-school program. No institution reassignments.
